title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for diabetes and kidney management.

HPI
The patient is a known patient presenting for a scheduled evaluation of type 1 diabetes and chronic kidney disease stage 4. The patient reports stable glucose levels and denies any new symptoms regarding renal function. They have been on long-term insulin therapy and report consistent adherence to their current regimen. No oral diabetes medication is used.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Physical examination reveals no new skin lesions or changes in renal status.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus.
2. CKD stage 4.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen as prescribed. Monitor renal function markers at the next visit. Patient instructed to report any significant changes in symptoms. Follow-up in three months.
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E10.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: 'With' presumes the link without 'due to' wording.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
